# Ho-Smart v0.2.2 — Restore integration startup

**Focus:** Correct a startup failure introduced in v0.2.1 so configured Ho-Smart receivers can load normally in Home Assistant again.

## Why this update was developed

Version 0.2.1 referenced the receiver node-ID configuration constant during setup without importing it, preventing affected integration entries from initializing.

## What changed

- Imported the missing `CONF_NODE_ID` constant in the integration's setup module.
- Restored successful configuration-entry setup and normal Home Assistant entity initialization.
- Preserved the Hybrid-mode local/cloud availability protections from v0.2.1.

## Limitations and testing

This is a targeted **startup regression fix**, not a new alarm-delivery mechanism. Driveway alarm detection still depends on the Ho-Smart cloud-history source being populated and reachable.

## Installation

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. You do not need to delete and recreate your configured receiver.

**Full changelog:** [Compare v0.2.1...v0.2.2](https://github.com/gigabytegrove/hosmart-home-assistant/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2)
